rationale: Item 7: a match-over-enum token NOT recognized for the variant CSS "still lowers — each token change is a separate `:root` write". The stylesheet's part is that the use site reads `var(--ink)`, so the script's `:root` write drives the element (a second write re-drives it). What the token resolves to BEFORE the first write is not ruled and is not asserted (review F1): a script write is an inline `:root` style, which beats any stylesheet `:root` rule, so the stylesheet's own contribution for this token is unobservable once the script runs. Token.ScriptWrites therefore has no stylesheet emission to certify; its behaviour is the clientJs half (dpa-051 §8.4 step 3).
